ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff / Sapphire Sleet fake-recruiter ISO→LNK→regsvr32 sideload chain
ucs.description: Hunts the Sapphire Sleet (TA444) recruiter-lure access pattern: a victim mounts an ISO/VHD or opens a ZIP from a fake LinkedIn / Telegram / job-board contact, the LNK or script inside spawns wscript.exe/cscript.exe which then proxy-executes a payload via regsvr32.exe or rundll32.exe loading a DLL/OCX/CPL masqueraded with a benign extension (.png/.log/.dat) from %TEMP%, %APPDATA% or Downloads. This DPAPI-protected, signed-binary-proxy chain is the same one Microsoft attributes to Sapphire Sleet's RustBucket/KANDYKORN delivery for crypto/fintech intrusions.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","explorer.exe","7zg.exe","winrar.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe","mshta.exe")) AND (Processes.process LIKE "%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%\\Downloads\\%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%\\Users\\Public\\%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%\\ProgramData\\%") by host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rex field=process "(?i)(?<bad_ext>\.(?:dll|ocx|cpl|dat|tmp|png|jpg|jpeg|log|cfg|ini))\b" | where isnotnull(bad_ext) | search NOT user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime host user parent_process_name parent_process process_name process bad_ext process_hash
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","explorer.exe","7zg.exe","winrar.exe","7zfm.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe","mshta.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Downloads\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\.(dll|ocx|cpl|dat|tmp|png|jpg|jpeg|log|cfg|ini)\b"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let SuspiciousParents = dynamic(["wscript.exe","cscript.exe","explorer.exe","7zg.exe","winrar.exe","7zfm.exe"]);
let ProxyBins = dynamic(["regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe","mshta.exe"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])) in (SuspiciousParents)
| where tolower(tostring(split(TargetProcessName, "\\")[-1])) in (ProxyBins)
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Downloads\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\")
| where TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\.(dll|ocx|cpl|dat|tmp|png|jpg|jpeg|log|cfg|ini)\b"
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Bluenoroff Sapphire Sleet ISO/LNK Script-to-Regsvr32 Sideload Chain
id: 9c4a8b1f-3a7e-4f2c-9d6b-7b4e9a1c2d8e
status: experimental
description: Detects the Sapphire Sleet (Bluenoroff / TA444) ISO-mount → LNK → wscript/cscript → regsvr32/rundll32 sideload chain where the proxy binary loads a DLL renamed to a benign extension from a user-writable directory.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/12/28/financially-motivated-north-korean-threat-actor-sapphire-sleet/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0098/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/28
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1218.010
  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.t1059.005
  - attack.t1036.005
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\7zg.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'
      - '\7zfm.exe'
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
  path_in_user_writable:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\AppData\Roaming\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
  masqueraded_payload:
    CommandLine|re|i: '\.(dll|ocx|cpl|dat|tmp|png|jpg|jpeg|log|cfg|ini)\b'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: parent and child and path_in_user_writable and masqueraded_payload and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate installers using regsvr32 from %TEMP% during MSI rollout (rare; pair with hash baselining)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\explorer.exe OR *\\Explorer.EXE OR *\\7zg.exe OR *\\winrar.exe OR *\\WinRAR.exe OR *\\7zFM.exe) @Image:(*\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\Regsvr32.exe OR *\\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE) @CommandLine:(*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\* OR *\\Downloads\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\*) @CommandLine:(*.dll* OR *.ocx* OR *.cpl* OR *.dat* OR *.tmp* OR *.png* OR *.jpg* OR *.log*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(wscript|cscript|explorer|7zg|winrar|7zfm)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(regsvr32|rundll32|mshta)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)\\\\(AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp|AppData\\\\Roaming|Downloads|Users\\\\Public|ProgramData)\\\\", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)\\.(dll|ocx|cpl|dat|tmp|png|jpg|jpeg|log|cfg|ini)\\b", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())
| sort(_count, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff SnatchCrypto wallet & browser-extension theft (T1115 + T1539 + T1176)
ucs.description: Hunts the Bluenoroff/TA444 SnatchCrypto post-compromise stage: a non-browser process reads MetaMask / Phantom / Binance / Trust Wallet browser-extension stores, browser cookie/login databases, or local wallet keystores. Bluenoroff's signature monetisation step is replacing the victim's clipboard wallet address and exfiltrating the encrypted vault — this query catches the off-browser read of extension settings or keystore files that precedes that swap.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path LIKE "%\\Local Extension Settings\\nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn%" OR Filesystem.file_path LIKE "%\\Local Extension Settings\\fhbohimaelbohpjbbldcngcnapndodjp%" OR Filesystem.file_path LIKE "%\\Extensions\\bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa%" OR Filesystem.file_path LIKE "%\\Local Extension Settings\\ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm%" OR Filesystem.file_path LIKE "%\\Local Extension Settings\\egjidjbpglichdcondbcbdnbeeppgdph%" OR Filesystem.file_path LIKE "%\\Ethereum\\keystore%" OR Filesystem.file_path LIKE "%\\Exodus\\exodus.wallet%" OR Filesystem.file_path LIKE "%\\Solana\\id.json%" OR Filesystem.file_path LIKE "%\\wallet.dat%" OR Filesystem.file_path LIKE "%\\Login Data%" OR Filesystem.file_path LIKE "%\\Cookies%") AND NOT (Filesystem.process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","explorer.exe","SearchProtocolHost.exe","OneDrive.exe","backup.exe","MsMpEng.exe")) by host Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.action | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | search NOT user IN ("*$","SYSTEM") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let WalletPaths = dynamic([
  @"\Local Extension Settings\nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn",  // MetaMask
  @"\Local Extension Settings\fhbohimaelbohpjbbldcngcnapndodjp",  // BinanceChain
  @"\Extensions\bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa",                // Phantom
  @"\Local Extension Settings\ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm",  // MetaMask Edge
  @"\Local Extension Settings\egjidjbpglichdcondbcbdnbeeppgdph",  // Trust Wallet
  @"\Ethereum\keystore",
  @"\Exodus\exodus.wallet",
  @"\Solana\id.json",
  @"\wallet.dat",
  @"\Login Data",
  @"\Cookies"
]);
let BrowserBins = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","explorer.exe","searchprotocolhost.exe","onedrive.exe","msmpeng.exe","backup.exe"]);
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FolderPath has_any (WalletPaths) or FileName in~ ("wallet.dat","id.json","Login Data","Cookies")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (BrowserBins)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            WalletArtifacts = make_set(FolderPath, 10),
            Reads = count()
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName,
               InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| where Reads >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WalletPaths = dynamic([
  @"\Local Extension Settings\nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn",
  @"\Local Extension Settings\fhbohimaelbohpjbbldcngcnapndodjp",
  @"\Extensions\bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa",
  @"\Local Extension Settings\ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm",
  @"\Local Extension Settings\egjidjbpglichdcondbcbdnbeeppgdph",
  @"\Ethereum\keystore",
  @"\Exodus\exodus.wallet",
  @"\Solana\id.json",
  @"\wallet.dat",
  @"\Login Data",

let BrowserBins = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","explorer.exe","searchprotocolhost.exe","onedrive.exe","msmpeng.exe","backup.exe"]);
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)

            WalletArtifacts = make_set(TargetFilePath, 10),
